home.question: What does Inori Kids do?
home.answer: Inori Kids designs, imports, installs and guarantees kids play areas, indoor play solutions, landscape furniture (pergolas, pavilions, benches), kids furniture and outdoor gym equipment in India. Inori Kids is an Indian company bringing world-class play and landscape solutions to India. We have tied up with Chungwoo Funstation, Spacetalk and Ittang of South Korea to bring the best designs and materials to India.

home.question: Who are your clients?
home.answer: Residential developers and housing societies, schools and preschools, malls and retail centres, and hotels and resorts. We also work with landscape architects and contractors on their projects.

home.question: How does a project with Inori Kids start?
home.answer: You give us the area, your site plan and what you want there. Developers and contractors often come with a space and a product in mind and ask us to design the area around it. Our award-winning design team then designs the complete play area, landscape or open gym for that space, and we import, install and guarantee it.

home.question: Do you sell off-the-shelf play equipment?
home.answer: No. We are a kids play area solution provider: every project is designed for the client's space, from the layout and safety zones to the equipment, surfacing and shade, and can include a one-of-a-kind landmark piece.

home.question: Where is the equipment made?
home.answer: In South Korea, in our partners' own factories, with in-house manufacturing and powder coating. We handle import, installation, warranty and after-sales in India.

home.question: Is the equipment safety certified?
home.answer: Our play equipment carries EN 1176 and ASTM international safety certifications and Korea's KC certification for children's products. Every installation is planned with safety zones and impact-absorbing surfacing matched to the critical fall height of each piece.

home.question: Which cities do you work in?
home.answer: We are based in Gurugram, Haryana, and take on projects across India, including Delhi NCR (Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad), Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Chandigarh, Jaipur and Lucknow.

home.question: How do I get a quote?
home.answer: Send your site details through our enquiry form, or call or WhatsApp Amol Sarin on +91 96504 41666 or Hosung Yoo on +91 78880 02985, or email hello@inorikids.com. We follow up with a site visit and a proposal.

outdoor_play.question: What equipment goes into a kids play area for a housing society?
outdoor_play.answer: A typical society play area combines one combination play structure (towers, slides, climbing), a separate toddler zone, freestanding swings or spinners, and impact-absorbing safety surfacing. Larger societies add a sculptural landmark piece, an in-ground trampoline or a water play feature.

outdoor_play.question: How much space does a kids play area need?
outdoor_play.answer: Each piece of equipment needs its own footprint plus a clear safety zone around it, typically at least 1.5 to 2 metres on every side. Even a compact area can hold a small combination unit and a toddler zone; a full society play area usually needs several hundred square metres. We work out the exact layout from your site plan.

outdoor_play.question: What does a kids play area cost in India?
outdoor_play.answer: Cost depends on the size of the area, the design (a complete play area or a sculptural landmark piece), the amount of safety surfacing, shade structures and site work. We give a detailed quote once we have designed the area for your space.

outdoor_play.question: Which safety standards does your playground equipment meet?
outdoor_play.answer: Our play equipment carries EN 1176 and ASTM international safety certifications and Korea's KC certification for children's products. Every installation is planned with safety zones and impact-absorbing surfacing matched to the critical fall height of each piece.

outdoor_play.question: Will the equipment survive Indian summers and monsoons?
outdoor_play.answer: The equipment is built for permanent outdoor use and long service life. During design we also plan shade, drainage and surfacing for local conditions, which matters as much as the equipment itself in Indian summers and monsoons.

outdoor_play.question: Do you install the play area and provide a warranty?
outdoor_play.answer: Yes. We handle import, installation and handover on site, and provide the manufacturer's warranty and after-sales support in India. Warranty terms are set out in your quote.

indoor_play.question: What is an indoor play area?
indoor_play.answer: An indoor play area is a climate-controlled play space inside a building, such as a mall, clubhouse, hotel, preschool or play café, fitted with play frames, slides, climbing nets and soft play on safe flooring. It lets children play year-round regardless of heat, rain or pollution.

indoor_play.question: How much floor area does a kids indoor play area need?
indoor_play.answer: A clubhouse kids room can work in a few hundred square feet; a mall play zone or play café usually needs a few thousand. Ceiling height matters as much as floor area, because double-height spaces allow multi-level net towers. We plan to your floor plate.

indoor_play.question: Do you design the full interior or just supply equipment?
indoor_play.answer: Both. We design complete children's interiors, including play structures, themed walls, flooring, lighting and furniture, or we can supply play equipment into a space designed by your architect.

indoor_play.question: Is indoor play equipment safe for toddlers?
indoor_play.answer: Yes, when toddlers have their own zone. We separate under-5 soft play from taller structures and use padded edges, enclosed platforms and impact-absorbing flooring. The play products carry Korean KC safety certification.

indoor_play.question: Can you fit an indoor play area into an existing mall or clubhouse?
indoor_play.answer: Yes. Structures are made in modules in Korea and assembled on site, so they can go into existing buildings. We check access routes, ceiling heights and floor loading during the survey.

landscape_furniture.question: What is landscape furniture?
landscape_furniture.answer: Landscape furniture, also called site furniture or street furniture, is the fixed outdoor furniture in a landscape: benches, pergolas, pavilions, shelters, planters, bollards and public art. It makes outdoor spaces comfortable and gives them a recognisable identity.

landscape_furniture.question: What is the difference between a pergola and a pavilion?
landscape_furniture.answer: A pergola is an open frame of posts and beams, sometimes with slats or a light canopy, that gives partial shade and defines a walkway or seating area. A pavilion is a fully roofed structure, sometimes enclosed with glass, that gives full shelter and can be used as a lounge, tea house or meeting space.

landscape_furniture.question: Can pergolas and pavilions be customised?
landscape_furniture.answer: Yes. Every pavilion and pergola is designed for your landscape plan, and our team also creates one-off pavilions and canopies around your brand.

landscape_furniture.question: Which materials suit Indian weather?
landscape_furniture.answer: For strong sun and heavy rain we recommend powder-coated steel or aluminium frames, stainless fixings, treated or composite timber and UV-stable finishes. Our partners powder-coat in-house, which keeps finish quality consistent.

landscape_furniture.question: Do you supply landscape furniture for podium gardens and terraces?
landscape_furniture.answer: Yes. We check loading, fixing details and wind exposure for podiums and terraces, and choose bases and anchoring to suit the slab.

outdoor_gym.question: What is an open gym or outdoor gym?
outdoor_gym.answer: An outdoor gym, also called an open gym, is a set of fixed, weather-proof exercise stations installed in a park, society or campus. Most stations use body weight as resistance, so they need no power, weights or supervision and are free for residents to use.

outdoor_gym.question: What outdoor gym equipment should a housing society install?
outdoor_gym.answer: A good society open gym combines a few strength stations (press and pull movements), one or two cardio stations such as a cross-trainer, a calisthenics bar frame and at least one senior-friendly balance or mobility station, placed along a walking track on rubber or turf surfacing.

outdoor_gym.question: How much space does an outdoor gym need?
outdoor_gym.answer: Each station needs its own footprint plus clear space for movement around it. A compact society open gym with six to eight stations typically fits in 100 to 200 square metres; a park fitness zone can be much larger. We plan layouts using the safety-zone principles of EN 16630, the European standard for outdoor fitness equipment.

outdoor_gym.question: Is outdoor gym equipment suitable for senior citizens?
outdoor_gym.answer: Yes, if you choose the right stations. Senior ranges focus on balance, flexibility and gentle strength with low step-on heights and handholds.

outdoor_gym.question: How do outdoor gym machines hold up to sun and rain?
outdoor_gym.answer: The stations are built for permanent outdoor installation, with powder-coated frames designed for long outdoor life. We recommend shade where possible and include care guidance at handover.

kids_furniture.question: What furniture does a preschool or daycare need?
kids_furniture.answer: Child-height tables and chairs for each age group, low open shelving and storage children can reach, a reading corner, role-play furniture such as a play kitchen, and soft seating. We plan these as themed learning areas: reading, blocks, art, making and role play.

kids_furniture.question: What material is your kids furniture made from?
kids_furniture.answer: Premium SE0-grade birch plywood with extremely low formaldehyde emission, designed and made in-house in Korea.

kids_furniture.question: Is the kids furniture safety certified?
kids_furniture.answer: Yes. The furniture holds Korea's KC safety certification for children's products and is tested under Korea's Special Act on the Safety of Children's Products.

kids_furniture.question: Can you furnish a clubhouse kids room or show flat?
kids_furniture.answer: Yes. We can supply furniture alone or design the full kids room, combining furniture with an indoor play structure, flooring and wall graphics.

bespoke_design.question: What is a bespoke or custom playground?
bespoke_design.answer: A bespoke playground is play equipment designed from scratch for one site. It is usually built around a theme, such as an animal, a local story or a brand, and becomes a landmark for the project.

bespoke_design.question: How does the bespoke design process work?
bespoke_design.answer: We start with your site plan, users and design intent. The partners' designers develop a concept and 3D design, engineer it for safety, manufacture it in their own factory in Korea, and we install it on site in India.

bespoke_design.question: Is a custom play structure safe?
bespoke_design.answer: Yes. Bespoke pieces are engineered to EN 1176 safety principles, with safety zones, fall heights and surfacing planned in the design.

bespoke_design.question: Can a bespoke design reflect our project's brand or theme?
bespoke_design.answer: Yes. That is the point of bespoke work. We are currently developing custom concepts for residential developers in India, each built around the developer's design intent.

planning_guide.question: How do you plan a kids play area for a housing society?
planning_guide.answer: Start with who will use it (ages and numbers), then measure the available site, allow for safety zones around each piece, decide whether you want a landmark centrepiece, specify safety surfacing to the right depth, add shade and seating for parents, and agree warranty and after-sales terms before ordering.

planning_guide.question: What age zones should a society play area have?
planning_guide.answer: At least two: a toddler zone for ages 1–5 with low platforms and small slides, and a junior zone for ages 5–12 with taller towers, climbing and faster slides. Keeping them apart reduces collisions and lets each zone be designed to the right fall height.

planning_guide.question: What is the safest surface for a kids play area?
planning_guide.answer: Impact-absorbing surfacing laid to the depth required for the critical fall height of the equipment above it. Poured EPDM rubber and rubber tiles are the most common in India because they are durable, drain well and need little upkeep. Hard surfaces such as concrete or tiles should never be used under play equipment.

planning_guide.question: How much shade does a play area need in India?
planning_guide.answer: As much as you can give it. Plan trees, pergolas or shade sails over the most-used equipment and seating, choose lighter surfacing colours, and orient slides away from direct afternoon sun, since metal and plastic surfaces can get very hot.
